result.description: A fictional rackmount control hub for tabletop automation labs and teaching studios, designed to coordinate low-voltage switches, indicator relays, and scripted light panels. It includes 24 isolated logic channels, configurable timing profiles, and a front-panel status matrix for quick visual monitoring. Built for bench-top experimentation rather than storage or graphics workloads, the Nimble Forge 24-Port Logic Hub emphasizes signal routing, sequenced triggers, and quiet operation in compact installations.
result.title: Nimble Forge 24-Port Logic Hub
result.title_description: 24-channel compact logic hub for educational automation and signal sequencing
